title: The dark room
note: Ibn al-Haytham's lamp experiment: the proof that light travels in straight lines, and the word it left behind on every camera.

beats.text: Your camera is named after a room
Cairo, Egypt, about a thousand years ago

beats.callsub: one small hole in the wall, nothing else
set apart, each burning on its own

beats.text: Now look at the far wall

beats.call: Three patches of light show up
beats.callsub: one patch for each lamp outside

beats.call: Cover one lamp with your hand
beats.callsub: that patch goes dark, the other two stay

beats.text: So light moves in straight lines
beats.sub: lamp, then hole, then wall, in a line

beats.text: That is how a camera works
beats.sub: a dark box with one small hole in it

beats.text: He wrote this down about the year 1020
